name: @epoch/simulation-runner
description: Epoch Simulation Runner service (W021): the thin, typed HOST FACADE over @epoch/simulation-fabric — job intake (W005 registration/request admission through the fabric's REAL pipelines, capability bindings pre-resolved against the REAL W007 capability registry with retire/deprecate semantics), run supervision (planning, pull-style execution through the SimulationExecutionPort seam, push-style start+result publication, cancellation), the one-shot driveSimulationJob driver, health/liveness as typed data, and deterministic snapshot/restore. Tenant-scoped with the typed tenant-isolation-rejected gate. In-memory reference behavior only: NO persistence, NO network servers, NO real processes; the service is a typed library surface with a driver, not an HTTP server (zero wall-clock, zero randomness — instants are caller-supplied).
